Attack on Saudi Airport Kills One, Injures Eight

An attack on Saudi Arabia's King Fahd International Airport late Wednesday night resulted in one death and eight injuries. The airport sustained damage, and some flights were diverted following the incident. Saudi airports have been repeatedly targeted by projectiles in recent days.
